segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Paul wrote to the believers in Rome about who they really were — not strangers, not outsiders.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: God's own Spirit tells your spirit the truth about you. Not a rumour, not a hope — a witness, given straight to you: you are a child of God.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Children first — and because children, inheritors. What the Father has belongs to the family, and the family includes you.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The terms were honest: share in his suffering, and you will share in his glory too.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Not earned by effort. Received by belonging.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You're not a visitor at the table — you're family. Heir with the Son. Come home.
